tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rā hu la'i gsang sgrub snying gi dum bu bzhugs so/ /

thog ma'i mgon po rgyal ba la/ /kun nas gus pas phyag 'tshal te/ / drang srong chen po'i sgrub pa yi/ /rim pa bdag gis bshad par bya/ 'di la gsum ste/ bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ las sbyor ro/ /dang po ni/ dus gnyan brgyad kyi tshe/ bshos bu dgu bskor te/ rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i mdun du rā hu la bskyed nas/ 'bod sngags brgya rtsa re bzlas te/ ba ling ta khā hi zhes pa dang*/ bstod bskul gyi sngags zla ba gcig /srod la yang 'dzin gtor gso zhing*/ 'bod sngags dang gtor ma btang la bstod bskul re bya'o/ /des ni bar chad med cing snying nye la 'khu ldog mi 'byung ba'i gnad dam pa'o/ / gnyis pa sgrub pa ni/ ri nag po'i rtse'am/ brag nag po'i drung la sogs par maṇ+ḍal gru gsum ro sol dang ra khrag gis byugs pa'i dbus su/ rten gtor bshos bu dgu bskor gyi gdan ling ga byas pa la/ gza'i tsa ka li btsugs te/ dar nag gi gur phub pa'i mdun du gtor chung re bshams la khrag gis bran no/ /de nas kha lho nub tu bltas la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ stong pa'i ngang du bsgom par byas la/ rang nyid ye shes kyi rā hu la dbu dgu phyag bzhi dud ka sbrul mjug 'khyil bar bsgom la/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas de 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstim nas/ mdun gyi rten gtor tsa ka li dang bcas pa stong pa'i ngang las/ 'jig rten pa'i rā hu la dud kha dbu dgu'i dbus gsum mthing nag g.yas gsum dmar nag /g.yon gsum ljang nag /steng na bya rog gi mgo can/ phyag dang po gnyis na chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan dang sbrul zhag /'og ma gnyis na mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ smad sbrul du 'khyil zhing*/ dbu rnams la spyan gsum gsum sku la spyan stong dmar rum me yod par bsams la/ hrī shag ru ram/ na ge tsit+ta traṃ/ ma ma yoṃ za gh+raṃ/ ha he yo ki sha la dza dzaḥ zhes pas/ rwa hu la 'khor lha srin sde brgyad dang bcas pa spyan drangs la bstim nas/

yid kyis mchod de/ 'bod sngags dang de'i gsham du/ sbra'i shag sbra'i shag /ha ha tshal pa tshal pa/ rum rum nyig nyig /'dur 'dur/ rgyug rgyug /ke te ke te rbad/ rā hu la/ dgra bo'i snying dang nang khrol la rbad/ sha rus pags pa la rbad/ bla tshe srog la rbad/ ces rbad sngags bzlas pa'i mthar/ dgra bo'i ling ga thod nang du bcug la nyung nag dang*/ dug khrag gis brab cing*/ sngags de'i gsham du/ hi wa ti ti sa ra kha ra ho ra ti shed thon che ge mo mā ra ya rbad/ ces bsad sngags bzlas shing*/ zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig sgrub bo/ /de yang dang po zhag bdun du 'bod sngags gtso bor bzlas shing*/ rbad bsad 'jog khar bzla'o/ /bar pa bdun la 'bod rbad dril la bzlas shing gsad sngags thun zhabs su bzlas so/ /tha ma bdun la 'bod rbad gsad gsum dril la bzlas shing bar bar du thun gyis brab bo/ /thun 'jog khar gtor ma btang zhing*/ hūṃ gza' mchog chen po rā hu la/ 'jig byed chen po drag rtsal can/ /pha ni srin la ma ni klu/ /klu srin tshogs pa'i mthu bo che/ /lus po gcig la mgo bo dgu /mgo lus med par mig gis khengs/ /sku ni 'jig pa'i dud kha la/ /g.yas pa rā yi mda' gzhu la/ /g.yon pa chu srin rgyal mtshan bsnams/ /lho nub mtshams nas sku bzhengs shig /tshes grangs bzhi yi srod dag la/ /nub nas shar du rgyu tsam na/ /ma mo yongs kyi dmag dpon byed/ /rims nad 'bebs pa'i mthu bo che/ /ma mo'i king kang dgra la bh+yoḥ tshes grangs brgyad kyi dros chen la/ / shar lho nub byang rgyu tsam na/ /dgra lha rgyal mo'i dmag dpon byed/ /yams nad 'bebs pa'i mthu bo che/ /dgra lha'i king kang dgra la bh+yoḥ tshes grangs bcu gcig dus tshod du/ /nam ni phyed nas phyed yol la/ /byang nas lho ru rgyu tsam na/ /gshin rje yongs kyi dmag dpon byed/ /bal nad 'bebs pa'i mthu bo che/ /gshin rje'i king kang dgra la bh+yoḥ /tshes grangs bco lnga'i nyin phyed la/

/lho nub byang shar rgyu tsam na/ /srin po yongs kyi dmag dpon byed/ /gri rgod gtong ba'i mthu bo che/ /srin po'i king kang dgra la ya/ /tshes grangs bco brgyad nam phyed la/ /shar nas nub tu rgyu tsam na/ /dmu rnams yongs kyi dmag dpon byed/ /bying nad gtong ba'i mthu bo che/ /dmu yi king kang dgra la ya/ /nyi shu gnyis kyi phyed yol la/ /nub byang shar lho rgyu tsam na/ /btsan rnams yongs kyi dmag dpon byed/ /gzer nad gtong ba'i mthu bo che/ /btsan gyi kang kang dgra la ya/ /nyi shu lnga yi skya rengs la/ /lho nas byang du rgyu tsam na/ /klu rnams yongs kyi dmag dpon byed/ /mdze nad gtong ba'i mthu bo che/ /klu yi king kang dgra la ya/ /nyi shu dgu yi myur smad na/ /byang shar lho nub rgyu tsam na/ /lha rnams yongs kyi dmag dpon byed/ / lha nad gtong ba'i mthu bo che/ /lha yi king kang dgra la ya/ /phyo phyo dam nyams dgra la phyo/ /gza' mchog nyi ma dgra la phyo/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i drod la rol/ /gza' mchog zla ba dgra la phyo/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i khrag la rol/ /gza' mchog mig dmar dgra la phyo/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i snying la rol/ /gza' mchog lhag pa dgra la phyo/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i dbugs la rol/ /gza' mchog phur bu dpal la phyo/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i rtsa rgyus rol/ /gza' mchog pa sangs dgra la phyo/ /dam nyams dgra yi rus la rol/ /gza' mchog spen pa dgra pa phyo/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i sha la rol/ /che go mo'i tsit+ta mā ra ya rbad bh+yo/ /zhes brjod nas thal mo brdab pa'i bar du dgra bo sgong lpags bcar pa bzhin du song bar bsams la/ gtor chung dgra phyogs su zor du 'phangs so/ /gsum pa las sbyor la 'phangs sreg mnan gsum las/ dang po 'phangs pa ni/ sgrub pa thon pa'i dus nyi shu dgu'i nyi ma mdung gang na/ rang nyid skra spyi bor bcings te/ rten gtor dkyil 'khor dbus na yod pa de khyer la/ dgra'i khang pa la brdeg go

/sreg pa ni/ ling ga tsher ma'i me nang du rā hu la bsam la bsregs pa'i thal ba lam rgya gram du mnan no/ /ser ba 'bebs na/ rten gtor la khar 'phangs shing mdze thod du rdzas ngan tshogs tshad blugs nas bkol la kha sbub pas de ma thag tu ser ba 'bebs so/ /yang rten gtor dgra phyogs su 'phangs la/ thod ngan ling ga dang bcas pa de klu yod nges pa'i chu mig gi mgor sha ru 'am dgo rus/ khru gang mtho gang pa'i dong brus te dong khar mdze rkang gi sgyed bu gsum btsugs pa'i steng du thod ngan ling ga can de btsugs te/ dug sna khrag snas khu bas phyed tsam bkang ba'i 'og dong nang du tsher ma can gyi shing gcor la/ me spar nas khol ba dang thod pa de me khrod du kha sbub la/ sas g.yogs pa gnam gang gi nyi ma nub dus bya'o/ /des ni las gzhung 'phangs sreg mnan gsum gyis bsdu ba zhes bya ste/ mi 'grub mi srid pa'i gnad do/ / de yang tshes brgyad nas rdzas rten gtor ma bshams la mtshams bcad de/ sgrub pa'i mgo zug nas/ nyi shu dgu'i nub mo thon par byas la/ gnam gang gi nub mo 'phangs sreg mnan gsum gyis las mtha' rdzogs par byed pa'o/ /'di nyid lag len dmar khrid du bkod pa ste/ srung ba dang bla rdo bcang pa la sogs pa ci yang mi dgos so/ /dus gnyan rnams la mchod bstod kyis bskang gso bya'o/ /des ni snying nye zhing las gang yang byed do/ /de ltar gza' mchog thugs kyi sgrub pa'i rim/ /gang ba mngon du phyung nas bkod pa des/ /'gro kun dam can rgya mtshos legs skyong zhing*/ /ji ltar bsam dgu yid bzhin 'grub par shog /gza'i rgyal po rā hu la'i gsang sgrub snying gi dum bu zhes bya ba/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul du bkod pa rdzogs so// // dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/
